identity.name: Odysseus
identity.one_liner: Self-hosted AI workspace for chat, autonomous agents, deep research, email, documents, and more — local-first, privacy-first, no telemetry.
identity.short_description: Odysseus is a self-hosted AI workspace that unifies chat, autonomous agents, deep research, email triage, document editing, calendar, notes, memory, and model serving into a single local-first interface. It runs on your own hardware against your own endpoints — no telemetry, no cloud dependency, and full data privacy.

positioning.why_it_matters: Odysseus matters because it offers a rare combination: a full-featured AI workspace that runs entirely on your own hardware. Most AI tools push you toward a hosted subscription — Odysseus gives you chat, agents, research, email, documents, and model management in one self-contained package, all while keeping your data local.
best_for: Developers who want a self-hosted all-in-one AI workspace with full data privacy
Users who run local models and need a polished UI for chat, agents, and tools
Teams evaluating self-hosted alternatives to cloud AI workspaces like ChatGPT or Claude
not_for: Users who prefer managed cloud services with no self-hosting overhead
Non-technical users unwilling to manage Docker or Python runtimes

core_strengths.title: All-in-one self-hosted workspace
core_strengths.description: Odysseus combines chat, autonomous agents, deep research, email triage, document editing, calendar, notes, memory, model serving, and more in a single application.
core_strengths.why_it_matters: Most AI tools require stitching together multiple services. Odysseus gives you everything in one local-first package without sending data to the cloud.

core_strengths.title: Local-first with privacy by default
core_strengths.description: Runs entirely on your hardware against your own model endpoints. No telemetry, no cloud dependency, and no third-party access to your conversations or data.
core_strengths.why_it_matters: Privacy is the default architecture, not an afterthought or a premium feature.

core_strengths.title: Agent loop built on opencode with MCP
core_strengths.description: Odysseus's agent system is built on opencode, with full MCP tool support, web browsing, file access, shell commands, and persistent memory.
core_strengths.why_it_matters: The agent isn't just a chat wrapper — it can take real actions, use tools, and evolve its own skills over time.

command_line.label: Install with Docker (recommended)
command_line.command: git clone https://github.com/pewdiepie-archdaemon/odysseus.git && cd odysseus && docker compose up -d --build
command_line.description: Clone the repository and start Odysseus with Docker. Open http://localhost:7000 when containers are healthy.

command_line.label: Install natively on Linux/macOS
command_line.command: git clone https://github.com/pewdiepie-archdaemon/odysseus.git && cd odysseus && python3 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt && python setup.py && python -m uvicorn app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 7000
command_line.description: Native install requires Python 3.11+. The Cookbook feature also needs tmux for background model operations.

command_line.label: Apple Silicon (GPU-accelerated)
command_line.description: Docker on macOS cannot use Metal GPU. Use the native script for GPU-accelerated model serving on M-series Macs.

seo_article.intro: Odysseus is a self-hosted AI workspace that brings together chat, autonomous agents, deep research, email management, document editing, calendar, notes, memory, and model serving into one local-first application. It runs entirely on your hardware against your own endpoints.
seo_article.what_it_is: Odysseus is an open agent resource to evaluate by action surface: what software it can operate, which tools or browser steps it touches, and how much supervision it needs before it can run real work.
seo_article.why_it_matters: The self-hosted AI space has many single-purpose tools — a chat UI here, an agent framework there, a model server somewhere else. Odysseus combines them into a cohesive workspace, making it practical to run your entire AI stack locally without stitching together disparate services.

use_cases.title: Local AI workspace for daily workflows
use_cases.description: Use Odysseus as your daily driver for chat, research, email, documents, and calendar — all connected to your own local or API-hosted models.

use_cases.title: Autonomous task execution with MCP tools
use_cases.description: Give the agent access to MCP servers, shell, files, and web search. Let it plan and execute multi-step tasks while you supervise.

use_cases.title: Private email assistant
use_cases.description: Connect IMAP/SMTP accounts for AI-powered summarization, auto-tagging, spam triage, and draft replies — all processed locally.

use_cases.title: Model discovery and serving
use_cases.description: Use the Cookbook to scan hardware, browse 270+ catalogued models by VRAM fit score, download, and serve them — all from the UI.

alternatives.title: Use Odysseus for breadth; dedicated tools for depth
alternatives.summary: Aider, OpenHands, and Claude Code are more focused on coding. Odysseus offers a broader workspace — email, documents, calendar, model serving — alongside agent capabilities.

alternatives.title: Use cloud workspaces for zero-setup convenience
alternatives.summary: ChatGPT and Claude require no setup and offer polished hosted experiences. Odysseus requires Docker or Python setup but keeps all data local with no telemetry.

faq.answer: Start with one safe workflow for Odysseus. Inspect official setup instructions, required credentials, execution logs, approval points, and failure recovery before expanding from a sandbox task into production automation.

faq.question: Is Odysseus open source?
faq.answer: Odysseus is listed with MIT based on the official source links in this profile. Re-check the repository, model card, or docs before production use.

faq.question: Who should evaluate Odysseus?
faq.answer: Odysseus is most worth evaluating for developers who want a self-hosted all-in-one AI workspace with full data privacy.

faq.question: Does Odysseus require a GPU?
faq.answer: No. Odysseus connects to any LLM endpoint — local or remote. The Cookbook model serving is optional and GPU-dependent. You can use it with API providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, or OpenRouter without any local GPU.

faq.question: How does Odysseus compare to running separate tools?
faq.answer: Odysseus combines chat, agents, deep research, email, documents, calendar, and model management into one application. The tradeoff is breadth over specialization — dedicated tools may go deeper on specific tasks.
